devices.name: Ace
devices.summary: Enrollment and activation completed under accepted pilot exceptions. The same identity survived a real OS reboot and subsequently accessed fleet authority. This is a historical test report, not a live membership query.

tests.name: Device key, credential installation and activation
tests.basis: Operator-reported successful execution; public device identity independently checked.

tests.name: Protected account and credential mount after OS reboot
tests.basis: Directly verified over authenticated SSH after one controlled reboot; same enrolled identity and required mount flags.

tests.name: Live fleet access after OS reboot
tests.basis: Operator-reported authenticated self read with unchanged membership and key; stopped authority services independently checked afterward.

tests.name: Encrypted backup and recovery unlock
tests.basis: Operator-reported recovery unlock, filesystem checks and offline database checksums.

tests.name: Isolated restore of enrolled authority
tests.basis: Operator-reported restoration of active membership and matching issuance; stopped services and absent clone mapper independently checked.

tests.name: Precise live failure diagnostics
tests.basis: Client software proposed in PR #73; deployment and real negative-result tests remain pending.

tests.name: Live diagnostic-reference submission
tests.basis: Client software proposed in PR #73; no live diagnostic reference has been submitted by this test workflow.

remaining: Sustained authority serving and a reviewed persistent network path. Authority services were stopped at the end of the tests.
Policy and credential freshness, renewal, loss and retirement procedures; the recorded expiry has not been extended.
Deploy and exercise precise failure diagnostics and diagnostic-reference submission.
Real cross-device isolation after Mako is enrolled.
Review and consolidate retained evidence. Full fleet-admission conditions remain separately tracked; accepted pilot exceptions do not close them.
